title: Olicity Cheese Cloth Roll,Grade 100,3x30Ft, 90 Sq Feet, Reusable Cheese Cloth with Closed Edges Fabric Fine Mesh Cloth, Unbleached Cotton Muslin Bulk Cheesecloth Roll for Straining, Crafts - 10 Yards
description:
About this item
Made from 100% natural pure cotton, no odor, no lint, no chemicals, easy wash and reusable.
Large Size - Free cut into desired size. Closed Edges & No Shed Lint - Prevent small threads drop in the food. Easy Clean - Reused many times with a simple rinse.
SGS Tested Grade 100 - Our woven fabrics is 56x41. Didn't reduce threads. No Easy to Tear - The higher threads per square inch, the higher cost. You got what you pay.
Chemical Free - Stuff poultry, wrap spices, craft customized projects, even use as cheesecloth table runner, all without chemicals. Unbleached Pure Cotton - Strain almond milk, cold brew coffee, juice, and any other foods without worrying.
Packed with vacuum sealed packaging to keep cheese cloths clean and fresh! Good for saving packaging materials and be beneficial to reducing carbon emission. You can strain the food with confidence.
